item.title: Ensapo JK ~Kuro Gyaru Bitch no Pichiman ni Tairyoushasei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Genroku Soft
  • 発売日: 2015-12-31
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 援サポJK～黒ギャルビッチのピチマンに大量射精～
  • 英語名: Ensapo JK Kuro Gyaru Bitch no Pichiman ni Tairyoushasei

别名

  • Fap Support JK

あらすじ

Salaried worker Yoshio Imai was a salaryman in a deadend job.

He busted his butt every day, came home to nothing, no hobbies, no girlfriend.

Then his company sent him “on business” to another office.

It was a discrete form of demotion, but it came with a travel stipend.

item.title: Gedou Seitokai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Genroku Soft
  • 発売日: 2012-07-15
  • スコア: 5.58/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 外道生徒会
  • 英語名: Gedou Seitokai

别名

  • Evil Principles Student Council

あらすじ

The son of the school’s principal is forced to join the student council.

He (protagonist) absolutely doesn’t want this. The other students and teachers don’t like him, but are intimidated by his father’s power.

Only Yukari, the vice president, gives him grief … and it’s a bit too much.
